newsitem.title: UK: GKN squeezed higher ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: GKN squeezed higher ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in GKN Plc rose in early trading on Tuesday, extending their recent rebound ahead of Thursday's results after late buying on Monday left the market short of stock, traders said.
"One broker went round late last night and they have just been squeezed a bit higher today, I don't think there is any stock around," said one market-maker.

The stock was up 16-1/2p at 962-1/2 by 0845 GMT, extending a rally since it tumbled to an 11-month low of 908p on February 20, unsettled by possible damages from a U.S. lawsuit that could reach $740 million.
Volume in the stock was a thin 16,241 shares.
GKN is on Thursday expected to post a rise in underlying pre-tax profits to between 360 million stg and 375 million, up from 322.4 million a year before.
"People are just a bit scared to be short ahead of the results," said another market-maker.
